units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 40:15">Targ. Is. XL, 15</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="D00264"><he>דּוּל</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Eruvin 20b:14">Erub. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>דרי ליה לד׳ בהדיה</he> he might carry the bucket with him.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104a:1">B. Mets. 104ᵃ</cite> top <he>איבעי לך … בד׳</he> you ought to have brought the water over from the large well by irrigating works.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a:2">Ib. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן … לד׳</he> if one hired working men for irrigating work.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 4a:22">M. Kat. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה דלי ד׳</he> was doing irrigating work.
<cite ref="Yevamot 97b:4">Yeb. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>דלאי דדלו ד׳</he> ye water drawers engaged in irrigation.—Pl. <he>דַּוְולִין</he>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2.
